503:t_008:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I'll back you up. I'm leaving the front line to you.」

503:t_009:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「What do we do, Miss $$スメラギ$$?」

503:t_009:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The plan was for $$ヒイロ$$ and $$ゼクス$$ to strike first and gauge the enemy's response, but if they won't use the Vice Foreign Minister, we simply fight head-on.」

503:t_010:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「Is $$バナージ$$ sensing something too...!?」

503:t_010:5.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Watch out! Something else is coming out!」

503:t_011:2.en:
$$エマ$$
「I thought that one was lost...!」

503:t_011:3.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「So the $$クロノ$$ goons salvaged it and hauled it out again!」

503:t_011:4.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Is the pilot another enhanced human...!?」

503:t_011:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$... is that you...?」

503:t_011:9.en:
$$グラハム$$
「But those eyes... they are truly an ominous sight.」

503:t_011:10.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「I can't believe it... Ensign $$リディ$$ would...」

503:t_011:11.en:
$$デュオ$$
「He's been a little off since around the end of the $$時獄戦役$$, but I never thought he'd go that far...!」

503:t_011:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「Drift through space in a normal suit and this is what happens to you.」

503:t_011:13.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! I'm so glad you're safe...!」

503:t_011:16.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'm no longer a member of $c.」

503:t_011:17.en:
$$リディ$$
「I am... the leader of $$クロノ$$'s operations force.」

503:t_011:18.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What are you saying, Ensign $$リディ$$!?」

503:t_011:19.en:
$$シン$$
「Did $$クロノ$$ scout you or something!?」

503:t_011:20.en:
$$リディ$$
「No... This was decided from the moment I was born.」

503:t_011:22.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's right. The $$マーセナス家$$ has served as members of $$クロノ$$ for generations.」

503:t_011:24.en:
$$ブライト$$
「A major $$地球連邦$$ government politician... no, the family line of the first prime minister of the $$宇宙世紀$$ were $$クロノ$$ members...!」

503:t_011:25.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's exactly why a thing like $$ラプラスの箱$$ came into being...」

503:t_011:27.en:
$$リディ$$
「I... learned the true meaning of $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

503:t_011:29.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's why I'm fighting you all now, to seal the Box... to free $$ミネバ$$ from $$ジオン$$!」

503:t_012:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$'s pressure is coming through the $$バンシィ$$'s $$サイコ・フレーム$$...!」

503:t_012:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To awaken his potential in a form like this...!」

503:t_012:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「Shut up, $$バナージ$$! If it weren't for you, I would...!」

503:t_012:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's useless, $$バナージ$$! Words won't reach $$リディ$$ right now!」

503:t_012:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Even so, not like this...!」

503:t_012:11.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Fight. If you try to run, that black $$ユニコーン$$ will crush you.」

503:t_012:12.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「So that's the future the $$ゼロシステム$$ saw.」

503:t_012:14.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「How you fight is for you to decide.」

503:t_012:15.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「And don't think your life belongs to you alone.」

503:t_012:17.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's... protecting the $$ユニコーン$$... and building a future together with $$オードリー$$...」

503:t_013:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That's right. There's something you have to do.」

503:t_013:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You can do it, right, $$バナージ$$?」

503:t_013:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I have no intention of fighting Ensign $$リディ$$.」

503:t_013:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But I will stop that black $$ユニコーン$$!」

503:t_013:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「So that's how you look down on me!」

503:t_013:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$! I'll bring you down with my own hands!」

503:t_013:8.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, concentrate your attacks on the black $$ユニコーン$$! If we stop $$リディ$$, the enemy commander, the battle is won!」

503:t_013:9.en:
$$メリーベル$$
「What an idiot! Not even using the Queen!」

503:t_013:10.en:
$$グエン$$
「It seems a little pride still remains inside him.」

503:t_013:11.en:
$$グエン$$
「Now then... let me watch how that turns out, and see the ending.」

503:t_013:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「Here I come, $$バナージ$$! I'll defeat you all and protect this world!!」

503:t_014:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Damn! Is the $$バンシィ$$'s tuning insufficient!」

503:t_014:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Stop it already, Ensign $$リディ$$! You must know what $$クロノ$$ has been doing!」

503:t_014:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You don't have to be bound by things like family or blood!」

503:t_014:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「Shut up, $$バナージ$$! You understand nothing!」

503:t_014:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「Neither the true meaning of $$ラプラスの箱$$! Nor the reason $$クロノ$$ exists!」

503:t_014:5.en:
$$シン$$
「Then tell us, Ensign! What is that true meaning!」

503:t_014:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What is $$クロノ$$ protecting!? How does that relate to your words about protecting the world!?」

503:t_014:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「...It's something... you have no need to know.」
